entities.name: Guidelight Voyagers
entities.description: Racing team of automatons from an unknown plane, lost in the Multiverse and competing in the Grand Prix to find a way home.

entities.name: Mendicant Core
entities.description: Machine and sole sapient being who captains and coordinates the Guidelight Voyagers.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: Multiplanar race the Voyagers compete in.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Plane where the Voyagers emerged from an Omenpath.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths between planes that opened after the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who mind controlled Mendicant while trying to recover his adopted child Loot.

events.summary: The Guidelight emerge onto Avishkar from an Omenpath and wander the plane.
events.quote: The Omenpath they transited through essentially opened around them and deposited them upon Avishkar before closing again.

events.summary: Mendicant encounters the Grand Prix and decides to use it to transit Omenpaths and return home.
events.quote: Under Mendicant's guidance, they deemed the infrastructure of the race to be a perfect iterative field

events.summary: In the second Grand Prix the Guidelight try new, unpredictable racecraft.
events.quote: the Guidelight revised their plans, attempting new and unpredictable methods of racecraft.

events.summary: In the final stage Mendicant's vehicle is wrecked and Jace mind controls him to recover Loot.
events.quote: Mendicant's vehicle was wrecked, and it was mind controlled by Jace Beleren

relations.quote: captained and coordinated by a single mind
